title: Integrated influence of a dictator
statement: For a subset $S\subseteq\{0\}$, define $f(S)=1$ if $0\in S$ and $f(S)=0$ otherwise. For $p\in\mathbb R$, take the Bernoulli subset expectation of a function $g$ to be $\sum_{S\subseteq\{0\}}p^{|S|}(1-p)^{1-|S|}g(S)$, and define its influence at coordinate $0$ to be $p(1-p)$ times this expectation applied to $S\mapsto(f(S\cup\{0\})-f(S\setminus\{0\}))^2$. Then $4\int_0^1 \operatorname{Inf}_p(f,0)\,dp=\frac23$.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying coordinate set is the singleton $\{0\}$
The function on subsets is the dictator indicator
